paragraphs.text: Aliban's Towers are spires on the world of Ulgrotha . The Towers were made with no doors or entrances. They are created by a goblin spell to make rocks grow beneath one's feet as a defense against enemies or as a campsite, trapping one either inside or outside of the tower. They were named after the legendary goblin wizard Aliban . The spell needed to create them has been taught to the inhabitants of Aysen as a show of goodwill by Eron . The citizens of Aysen have built their cobblestone roads thanks to this: a wizard would cast the spell, then workers would tear the structure down and use the stones for the roads. Some towers still dot the Koskun Mountains . Feroz and Sandruu nearly camped among them one night before being ambushed by a Root Spider .
